messages.subject: Re: append/merge occs.xy with occs.grp
parts:
Hi Dimitris,

You need to use the cbind function. I hope that this code works for you.

occs.xy <- occs[c('longitude', 'latitude')]
group.data <- ENMeval::get.block(occ=occs.xy, bg.coords=bg.xy)
occs.xy.grp <- cbind(occs.xy, group.data[[1]])
write.csv(occs.xy.grp, file = "")

Best,
Gonzalo
